'''Bantha Rock''' was a large rock formation, located in the deserts of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was named for its resemblance to the native [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] when viewed from nearby [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].
